data.narrative:
Roboneers is a Growth-stage frontier-tech company operating in Defense & Security, founded by Anton and Oleksiy Skrypnyk. The company has raised $2M+ to date. The Defense & Security sector contains 10 comparables (2 public, 8 private), including notable peers such as Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Valuation triangulation relied on a single applicable method: Stage-Progression analysis. Using the $2M total raised as a proxy for entry value and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $2.4M. Peer-Median methodology was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-set comparables; while 26 same-sector peers exist in Defense & Security broadly, none met the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier classification, falling below the three-datapoint threshold required for robust median construction.

The triangulated valuation range is $2.0M (low) to $2.76M (high), with a median of $2.4M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single method. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 1.2x stage multiplier for this company's specific risk and growth trajectory, and the absence of directly comparable peer data in the Defense & Security frontier-tech segment at the Growth stage. Deeper due diligence on revenue traction, customer concentration, and technical differentiation would be required to validate or adjust this preliminary range.
